rules.statement: The plaintiff-appellant's acquisition of ownership while being the landlord to the defendant respondent does not fall within the statutory bar in section 22.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. The plaintiff-appellant has acquired ownership of the said premises whilst being the landlord of the defendant respondent; the statutory bar in section 22(7) would not be applicable to him. The proviso is specific and must be within its terms. It does not include a landlord who was the landlord of the premises let before the tenancy arose

rules.statement: A landlord who was not the landlord at the inception of the tenancy does not fall within the terms of the proviso.
